name: Explorer's World Map & Minimap V2
description: A customizable Bedrock world map and minimap addon designed to provide detailed navigation and exploration features.

name: Enhanced Survival
description: A survival expansion that adds progression, mastery, magic, skills, quests, and an optimized minimap with real-time players, animals, and hostile mobs.

name: Realistic Survival [Achievement friendly]
description: A survival addon that adds hydration and temperature systems, requiring players to manage thirst, body heat, clothing, shelter, and purified water.

name: Survival Reworked
description: A survival overhaul that extends progression with artifacts, craftable spawners, over 100 new mobs, bosses, biomes, dungeons, ruins, and new challenges.

name: Core Craft - A Vanilla Expansion | NEW: The End Update
description: A Vanilla+ survival expansion featuring new world generation, mobs, animals, quests, structures, furniture, farming, cooking, and an expanded End.

name: Better on Bedrock
description: A comprehensive Bedrock expansion that adds polished gameplay content, improved progression, and new survival features while preserving Minecraft's core feel.

name: FPS Booster | Fps Boost
description: A Minecraft Bedrock performance pack that removes particles and animations, limits render distance, and reduces lag and device heat for smoother gameplay.

name: Boosted FPS (Optimized Performance)
description: A lightweight Bedrock resource pack that optimizes fog, particles, animations, sounds, and UI to maximize FPS and reduce lag on low-end devices.

name: FPS Optimizer | FPS Boost Official
description: A lightweight Bedrock performance pack that reduces particles, optimizes fog, simplifies animations and sounds, and provides selectable performance modes for smoother FPS.

name: Origin Animation ( Alt For Actions And Stuff )
description: An animation pack for Minecraft Bedrock that adds 30 new animations to give player movement and actions a more dynamic feel.

name: Astraliyte's Animated Textures
description: A Bedrock resource pack that adds animated textures to 39 items including diamonds, buckets, redstone, ender pearls, golden apples, and other materials.

name: Better Animated Nature
description: An environmental resource pack that adds smooth animations to foliage, grass, plants, crops, flowers, water, and lily pads for a livelier world.

name: Fay's Player Animation | v1.0.6 Particle Update
description: A player animation pack that smooths vanilla movement with custom animations for walking, sprinting, jumping, swimming, flying, sneaking, sleeping, and more.

name: MCPE OLD animations
description: A nostalgic Bedrock animation pack that recreates classic animations from older versions with old-style player, first-person, riding, sneaking, and attachable animations.

name: Moving Textures (Official Port)
description: A resource pack that continuously animates block textures in every direction with three selectable movement speeds: slow, normal, and fast.

name: Miku nakano totem animated
description: An anime-themed resource pack that replaces the Totem of Undying with a custom animated Miku Nakano design while keeping gameplay unchanged.

name: Karene inda Totem animated
description: An anime-style resource pack that replaces the Totem of Undying with a custom Karane Inda design while preserving the original gameplay mechanics.
